title: On the Hodge conjecture for Fermat varieties
description:
Complete 86-page amsart research revision by Deep Bhattacharjee. Adds two verified references to Hongmin Li, acknowledges his September precedent for Theorem B and the diagonal-class counterexample, distinguishes the later six-residual classification from the three-terminal profile descent, and adds Appendix C with an inflation lemma, a comparison diagram and exact checks of seven named tuples. The whole earlier paper is retained, with its title and sole author unchanged. Claims of exclusive priority for the overlapping odd-degree conclusion are removed. The review does not independently certify Li's infinite conductor arguments.

Theorem A gives the stated all-dimensional Fermat degree-family results. Theorem B has a profile-descent proof of the all-odd-degree fourfold conclusion also stated in Li's earlier September preprint. The universal Hodge conjecture remains unproved; CM-based deductions retain their explicit hypothesis.
